mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY QNA_ID DESC) RNUM, QNA_ID AS QNA_NO, TITLE AS QNA_TITLE, QNA_NAME, TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS QNA_DATE FROM QNA_POSTS
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QNA_POSTS ( MEMBER_ID, QNA_NAME, TITLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{MEMBER_ID, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{QNA_NAME, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{TITLE, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{CONTENT, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
